The '''Gobindi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained twelve planets. The fifth planet of the system was [[Gobindi]].
